name: com.askasteria/asteria
title: Asteria: Astrology & Tarot
description: Horoscope from your birth chart, zodiac, Moon, tarot readings, Kabbalah rituals, the 150 psalms.

tools.name: my_day
tools.description: The person's own horoscope for today, read on her birth chart exactly as the Asteria app's home screen reads it: the transit that leads her day (the app's ranking of every contact between today's sky and her chart), the app's text for that day (a hook and what the day brings her, what to do with it), where the transit stands (peaking today, until a date), then the Moon of the day in her natal house with its text, and the house the Moon reaches tomorrow. Needs her birth date, time and place. Use it for "my horoscope", "my day", "what's in store for me today".

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, east positive.

current_timezone.description: IANA time zone where she is today, which cuts her day (default: her birth time zone).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Computes a natal chart from a birth date, with optional birth time and place: the sign and degree of the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Chiron and the North Node, the major aspects between them, and, when the time, time zone and coordinates are given, the Ascendant (rising sign), Midheaven, the twelve Placidus houses and the house of each planet. Returns the full reading of the Sun, Moon and rising sign (the big three) and a one-line reading of every other placement. Use it for any question about someone's birth chart, big three, or planets in signs and houses.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, east positive.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: sun_sign
tools.description: Finds the zodiac sign (Sun sign, star sign) of a birth date and returns its reading: personality, strengths, what holds one back, what helps. On a day when the Sun changes sign, give the birth time and time zone to settle it; otherwise both possible signs are returned.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: moon_sign
tools.description: Finds the sign of the Moon at a birth and returns its reading (emotions, needs, what brings security). The Moon changes sign every two to three days: without a birth time, every sign it crossed that day is returned.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: rising_sign
tools.description: Computes the Ascendant (rising sign) and Midheaven from a birth date, time and place, with the reading of the rising sign and the twelve Placidus house cusps. Needs the birth time, the time zone and the coordinates of the birth place.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, east positive.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: sign_compatibility
tools.description: Reads the love compatibility of two zodiac signs: what draws them together, their strengths as a couple, what can go wrong between them. Use it for questions such as « are Leo and Aries compatible? ».

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: sky_today
tools.description: The astrology of a day (default today): the signs of the Sun and the Moon, the Moon phase named for that day and its lit fraction, the next new moon and full moon with their signs and whether either is an eclipse, and what the current phase means. For questions about today's astrology, the Moon today or the next full moon. It does not depend on a birth chart.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to cut the day (default UTC).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: tarot_draw
tools.description: Draws 1 to 10 distinct cards at random from the 78-card tarot deck and returns the reading of each, in the order drawn: a card of the day, or a free spread whose positions you assign in that order. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: tarot_yes_no
tools.description: Answers a yes-or-no question with the tarot, by the app's rule: major arcana are turned over one by one until a card decides (Judgement says yes, The Hanged Man says no, The Fool asks to rephrase the question). Returns the answer, the deciding card with its reading, and the cards turned before it, which tell why. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

deck.description: majors: the 22 major arcana (default); full: all 78 cards.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: tarot_spread
tools.description: Lays out one of the app's tarot spreads (Single card, Question · Answer, Three cards, Lunation arc, Relationship mirror, Decision fork, Seven cards, Celtic Cross, Twelve houses) and draws a card for each position. Returns the spread, then for every position its name, what that position means and the card drawn with its reading. By default only the 22 major arcana are drawn, as in the app; deck "full" draws from all 78. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

deck.description: majors: the 22 major arcana (default); full: all 78 cards.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: tarot_card
tools.description: The meaning of one of the 78 tarot cards, by name (The Moon, Ace of Cups, Queen of Swords…, in the chosen language or English) or by number (0 The Fool … 21 The World, then 22–77 the minor arcana).

name.description: Card name, e.g. The Moon, Ace of Cups.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: ritual
tools.description: Finds rituals in the Asteria app's catalogue and returns the ritual as the app writes it: when to do it (Moon phase, day), what you need, every step in order with the words to say and the verses each step has you say, then what it is, why do it and what makes it magic. Kabbalah comes first (the Kabbalistic Cross, the pentagram, the elements, the shield of David, the middle pillar). Search by intention (beginning, calm, clarity, cleansing, confidence, energy, gratitude, grief, home, love, money, protection, release, work), by Moon phase ("today" for the phase of the day), by family, or by name. With a birth date (and time), it returns the three guardian angels (genii) of that birth among the seventy-two, with the psalm verse said to each at its hour.

moon_phase.description: A Moon phase, or "today" for the phase of the day.

name.description: A ritual's name or id, e.g. Kabbalistic Cross, qabalistic-cross.

birth_date.description: Birth date, YYYY-MM-DD: returns the guardian angels (genii) of that birth.

birth_time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM: adds the angel of the hour of birth.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to cut the day for moon_phase "today" (default UTC).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

tools.name: psalm
tools.description: One of the 150 psalms of the Asteria app, in full, verse by verse, by number (Hebrew numbering; its Latin number is noted when it differs), with what it is used for: the guardian angel who says one of its verses, what it is said against, the rituals that have it said. Or, with "against", which psalms to say against something, as the app lists them ("Which psalm to say against…"): crowd, lies, talk, envy, hatred, enemies, wickedWoman, wickedMen, powerful, diabolical, blackMagic, evilForces, evilEye.

number.description: Psalm number, 1–150 (Hebrew numbering, e.g. 91 for the Latin 90).

against.description: What to say a psalm against.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.
